related.title: SPIRE 註冊：選擇器交集與身分誤授風險
related.titleEn: SPIRE registration: selector intersections and unintended identity grants
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩種餘裕均可重算；信任域綁定與斷線例外仍保留，不能為了讓舊客戶端通過而接受任何域的根。 交付rotation.csv、信任域對照圖、離線客戶端反例與重試條件；表內不放私鑰或真實工作負載身分。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce both margins while retaining domain binding and disconnected exceptions. Never make an old client pass by accepting a root from an unrelated domain. Deliver rotation.csv, the trust-domain map, disconnected-client counterexample and retry conditions. Include public test identifiers only, with no private keys or real workload identities.
related.difference: 建立12筆合成程序記錄，分別含節點、namespace、service account及映像摘要；先固定parent身分，再畫出三項工作負載選擇器的交集。
related.differenceEn: Create 12 synthetic process records containing node, namespace, service account and image digest. Hold the parent identity fixed, then draw the intersection of three workload-selector sets.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 新根先傳播再用來簽發；本地保守傳播預算採三次刷新間隔加內部散布延遲。這是教學服務目標，並非規格保證所有客戶端準時刷新。 刷新提示120秒、散布延遲45秒，預計發布後600秒切換簽發；所有時鐘已對齊，未計連續斷線。 可用餘裕600−(3×120+45)=195秒；刷新間隔改180秒時餘裕只剩15秒，不能仍宣稱同樣容錯能力。
選擇器必須共同成立；重複觀測同一程序不能增加可授權程序數。用明列的集合交集對照註冊條目，並將節點認證與工作負載認證分層。 namespace與service account共同符合的程序有8筆，其中5筆映像摘要也符合；變更摘要白名單後另有2筆符合，母體仍12筆。 初始可授權比例5/12×100=41.6666667%；修訂後7/12×100=58.3333333%，其餘不得因同節點就取得此身分。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Publish a new root before using it to issue identities. The local conservative budget uses three refresh intervals plus internal dissemination delay; this is a teaching service objective, not a guarantee that every client refreshes on time. Use a 120-second refresh hint, 45-second internal dissemination delay and issuance cutover 600 seconds after publication. Clocks are aligned; prolonged disconnection is deliberately outside the nominal model. Margin is 600−(3×120+45)=195 seconds. Increasing refresh to 180 seconds leaves 15 seconds, demonstrating that unchanged cutover time does not preserve the original delay tolerance.

Required selectors must hold together; observing a process twice does not create another eligible process. Compare explicit set intersections with registration entries while separating node attestation from workload attestation. Eight processes jointly match namespace and service account; five also match the image digest. An approved digest-list revision admits two more of those eight, while the population remains 12. Eligible share is 5/12×100=41.6666667%; the revision yields 7/12×100=58.3333333%. Remaining processes must not receive the identity merely because they share a node.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TLS Delegated Credentials：代理憑證的有效期交集
related.titleEn: TLS Delegated Credentials: delegated authority lifetime intersections
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：兩種餘裕均可重算；信任域綁定與斷線例外仍保留，不能為了讓舊客戶端通過而接受任何域的根。 交付rotation.csv、信任域對照圖、離線客戶端反例與重試條件；表內不放私鑰或真實工作負載身分。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce both margins while retaining domain binding and disconnected exceptions. Never make an old client pass by accepting a root from an unrelated domain. Deliver rotation.csv, the trust-domain map, disconnected-client counterexample and retry conditions. Include public test identifiers only, with no private keys or real workload identities.
related.difference: 建立父憑證、DelegationUsage、代理公鑰與預期簽章演算法的測試描述；對缺授權、錯演算法及超出父有效期各留一個反例，先寫拒絕理由。
related.differenceEn: Create descriptors for the parent certificate, DelegationUsage authorization, delegated public key and expected signature algorithm. Include missing authorization, wrong algorithm and excessive lifetime as separate counterexamples with decisions written before evaluation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 新根先傳播再用來簽發；本地保守傳播預算採三次刷新間隔加內部散布延遲。這是教學服務目標，並非規格保證所有客戶端準時刷新。 刷新提示120秒、散布延遲45秒，預計發布後600秒切換簽發；所有時鐘已對齊，未計連續斷線。 可用餘裕600−(3×120+45)=195秒；刷新間隔改180秒時餘裕只剩15秒，不能仍宣稱同樣容錯能力。
代理驗證包含簽章、演算法與時間要求；本課僅計算已通過其他檢查者的剩餘時間，採父憑證餘期與代理餘期的較小值，不將最小值運算代替協定驗證。 在共同觀測時點，父憑證尚餘7200秒，代理憑證尚餘1800秒；所有描述使用相同UTC時基且在規格允許的期限內。 共同可用時間min(7200,1800)=1800秒；只縮短父餘期至900秒時，變為900秒，不能保留原來的代理餘期結論。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Publish a new root before using it to issue identities. The local conservative budget uses three refresh intervals plus internal dissemination delay; this is a teaching service objective, not a guarantee that every client refreshes on time. Use a 120-second refresh hint, 45-second internal dissemination delay and issuance cutover 600 seconds after publication. Clocks are aligned; prolonged disconnection is deliberately outside the nominal model. Margin is 600−(3×120+45)=195 seconds. Increasing refresh to 180 seconds leaves 15 seconds, demonstrating that unchanged cutover time does not preserve the original delay tolerance.

Delegation requires signature, algorithm and time checks. This exercise calculates remaining time only after the other checks pass, taking the smaller parent and delegated remainder; the minimum operation is not a substitute for protocol validation. At a common observation instant the parent has 7200 seconds remaining and the delegated credential has 1800. Use a shared UTC time base and descriptors within the specification lifetime bounds; do not infer validity from file creation times. The common usable interval is min(7200, 1800)=1800 seconds. Reducing only the parent remainder to 900 makes it 900 seconds; an unchanged delegated descriptor cannot preserve authority beyond its parent.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
